verdict.rationale: An IP office could publish an API, XML schemas, or a data dictionary for its filing or data channels, so this story applies to INPI Portugal. The evidence pack only describes patent, trademark and design procedures and online filing guides, with nothing on any OpenAPI spec, XML schema, or data dictionary. The llms.txt 404 probe concerns an agent docs index, not a machine-channel specification.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
